DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの靴をお試しになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to try these shoes?

DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。二十四センチを両足で試したいです。右足の方が少し大きいので。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 左右両足試着と右足の差を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I would like to try the 24-centimeter size on both feet, because my right foot is a little bigger.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to try both shoes and explain the difference in your right foot. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 両方お持ちします。こちらの椅子でどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will bring both shoes. Please use this chair.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 左はちょうどいいですが、右のつま先が当たります。一つ上も試せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 右つま先が当たり上サイズを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The left fits just right, but my toes touch the front on the right. Could I try the next size up too?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that your right toes touch the front and ask for a larger size. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二十四・五センチをお持ちしました。

DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 右のつま先は楽です。でも左のかかとが浮きます。幅が違う型もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 左かかとの浮きから別幅型を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: My right toes feel comfortable. But my left heel slips up. Do you have another style with a different width?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that your left heel slips and ask about a style with a different width. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 同じサイズで、幅が広いこちらの型があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We have this wider style in the same size.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この型の二十四センチなら両足とも合いそうです。少し歩いてみてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 広幅型で歩いて試す許可を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The 24-centimeter size in this style seems likely to fit both feet. May I walk around a little to try them?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask permission to test the wider style by walking. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの敷物の上でお試しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please try walking on this mat.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 歩いてもかかとが浮きません。この型の二十四センチを買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 歩行結果から型とサイズを決定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: My heels do not slip even when I walk. I will buy this style in the 24-centimeter size.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide on the style and size based on the walking test. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらをご用意します。お買い上げありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will get these ready for you. Thank you for your purchase.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は切身を並べています。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: We have fish fillets on display today.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夕飯に焼き魚を作ります。三人分で、同じくらいの厚さの物を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三人分の同程度厚さの魚を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am making grilled fish for dinner. I would like to choose pieces of roughly the same thickness for three people.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for fish of similar thickness for three people. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの三切れはいかがですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: よさそうです。一切れずつ包んでいただけますか。一人は帰る時間が遅いので。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 帰宅差があり個別包装を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: They look good. Could you wrap each piece separately? One person gets home late.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the difference in homecoming times and request individual wrapping. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 個別に包めます。持ち帰りにどのくらいかかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can wrap them separately. How long will it take you to get home?

DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三十分ほどです。保冷剤も付けてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 三十分の移動を伝え保冷剤を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: About thirty minutes. I would like an ice pack too.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that your journey takes thirty minutes and ask for an ice pack. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 保冷剤を付けます。こちらの表示には保存方法もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will include an ice pack. This label also gives storage instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。遅く帰る人の分だけ、袋へ丸印を付けてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 遅い帰宅者用の一袋へ丸印を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. Could you put a circle on just the bag for the person who gets home late?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for a circle to be marked on the one bag for the late arrival. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 一つに丸を付けます。三つを外袋へまとめますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will mark one with a circle. Shall I put all three into an outer bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まとめてください。家では三つを分けて冷蔵庫へ入れます。この三切れでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: まとめ袋と自宅で分ける保管を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please put them together. At home, I will separate the three and put them in the refrigerator. I will take these three pieces.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for an outer bag and explain that you will separate the pieces for storage at home. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。どうぞお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 市民展示へのお申込みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you applying to the community exhibition?

DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分で描いた絵を出したいです。申込票の作品名は、まだ決まっていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未定題名の絵を展示申込する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to submit a picture I painted myself. I have not decided the title to put on the application form yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Apply to exhibit your picture while its title is still undecided. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日の受付では仮の名前でもお預かりできます。大きさを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-03.translation: For today's application, we can accept a provisional title. Please tell me its size.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 額を含めて横四十センチ、縦三十センチです。横向きで展示したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 額込寸法と横向きを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: Including the frame, it is forty centimeters wide and thirty centimeters high. I would like it displayed horizontally.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the dimensions including the frame and request horizontal display. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 向きも記入します。展示札には、作者名と作品名を載せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will record the orientation too. The display label will show the artist's name and the work's title.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 作者名はこの名前でお願いします。作品名は「雨の帰り道」に決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 作者名と作品名を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please use this as the artist's name. I have decided to call the picture "The Way Home in the Rain."
DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide the artist's name and the work's title. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、記入後に展示札の見本をお見せします。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: After entering the information, I will show you a sample display label.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 見本の字は読みやすいですね。作品名の「雨」が「雪」になっているので、そこを直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 展示札の雨と雪の誤記を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: The lettering on the sample is easy to read. But "Rain" in the title has become "Snow," so please correct that part.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Correct the mix-up between rain and snow on the display label. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 雨へ直しました。こちらでいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have corrected it to "Rain." How is this?

DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 合っています。横向きの絵とこの展示札でお願いします。搬入の日も控えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 札と展示向き搬入日を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: It is correct. Please use this label and display the painting horizontally. I have also noted the delivery date.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the label, display orientation, and delivery date. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お申込みを承りました。展示を楽しみにしております。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-09-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your application has been accepted. We look forward to the exhibition. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご相談の資料をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you brought the documents for your consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一年の入金を表にしました。月ごとの合計と、入金日ごとの明細があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 入金表の合計と明細を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: I made a table of the year's incoming payments. It has monthly totals and details for each payment date.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Present the totals and details of your incoming-payment table. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 担当が両方を見られるよう、別々にお出しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please present them separately so that the person in charge can see both.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらが月の合計です。明細は二枚に続いています。順番を付けた方がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二枚明細の順序表示を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: These are the monthly totals. The details continue over two sheets. Should I mark their order?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about indicating the order of the two detail sheets. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 順番が分かる番号を付けると、説明しやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: Adding numbers that show the order will make it easier to explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一枚目と二枚目に番号を書きます。返金を受けた行には、何の返金かも書き足します。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ページ番号と返金事情を追記する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will number the first and second sheets. On the row where I received a refund, I will also add what the refund was for.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Add page numbers and information about the refund. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 返金の事情は担当へご説明ください。資料に対応する書類はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please explain the circumstances of the refund to the person in charge. Do you have documents corresponding to the table?

DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 返金の通知があります。表の行と同じ日付の付箋を付けて持って行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 対応する返金通知を日付で結ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have the refund notice. I will attach a sticky note with the same date as the row in the table and bring it along.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Link the corresponding refund notice to the table by date. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 税務上の扱いは、担当がその資料を見て確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will examine those documents to confirm the tax treatment.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず表の見出しを説明してから、返金の行と通知を見せます。相談する順番が決まりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資料説明の順番を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will first explain the table headings, then show the refund row and notice. I have decided the order for the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide the order in which to explain the documents. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、資料をお持ちになって相談席へどうぞ。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take your documents to the consultation seat. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ラーメンを一杯と、追加の麺をお願いします。追加分は後で頼む形ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一杯と追加麺の注文方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-02.translation: One bowl of ramen and an extra serving of noodles, please. Do I order the extra serving later?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to order one bowl and an extra serving of noodles. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最初にお求めいただき、食事中にこちらの札でお知らせいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can purchase it at the start and use this token to let us know during your meal.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 最初の麺を食べ終わる頃に札を出すのですね。追加分だけ少なめにもできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 追加時点と少量対応を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I show the token when I am about to finish the first noodles. Can just the extra serving be a smaller portion?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask when to request the extra noodles and whether a smaller portion is possible. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 半分の量をご用意できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can provide a half portion.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それなら追加は半分にします。最初の一杯は普通の量でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本体普通量と追加半分を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will have half for the extra serving. Please make the initial bowl the regular amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify a regular initial bowl and a half portion of extra noodles. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 普通の一杯と追加半分ですね。麺の硬さはいかがしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-07.translation: One regular bowl and a half portion of extra noodles, correct? How firm would you like the noodles?

DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: どちらも普通でお願いします。追加の札は、丼の横へ置いておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 両方普通硬さと札の置場を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-08.translation: Regular firmness for both, please. I will leave the extra-noodle token beside the bowl.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request regular firmness for both and say where you will put the token. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらが札です。お出しになる時、係へ見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is the token. Show it to a staff member when you want to use it.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受け取りました。まず一杯をいただいて、必要な時に札で追加を頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 札を受取り食事中に追加を知らせると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have received it. I will have the first bowl and use the token to request the extra noodles when needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Accept the token and say that you will use it to request the extra noodles during your meal. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ごゆっくりお召し上がりください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-11-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy your meal. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 串の盛合せをご用意しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-01.translation: Shall we prepare an assortment of skewers?

DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人で食べます。肉と野菜を別の皿にしていただけますか。種類が分かると選びやすいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 肉野菜の別皿盛りを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-02.translation: Two of us will eat. Could you put the meat and vegetables on separate plates? It is easier to choose if we can tell the types apart.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for meat and vegetable skewers to be served on separate plates. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二皿でお出しできます。肉の方は何本にしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can serve them on two plates. How many meat skewers would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 肉は四本、野菜は六本にします。同じ種類が二本ずつ入る組合せが希望です。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本数と各二本の組合せを指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-04.translation: Four meat skewers and six vegetable skewers. I would like a combination with two of each type.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify the numbers of skewers and a combination with two of each type. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 肉は二種類、野菜は三種類で組めます。こちらの一覧からお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can make that with two types of meat and three types of vegetables. Please choose from this list.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 肉は牛と鶏、野菜は玉ねぎ、なす、しいたけでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 五種類の串を具体的に選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-06.translation: For meat, beef and chicken; for vegetables, onion, eggplant, and shiitake mushrooms, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the five types of skewers specifically. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その五種類ですね。お出しする時に、順番をご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-07.translation: Those five types, correct? We will explain the order when serving them.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。皿に並べた順番が分かれば、友人にも伝えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 配列説明が友人へ伝える助けになると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. If I know the order on the plates, I can tell my friend too.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that an explanation of the arrangement helps you tell your friend. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらが肉、こちらが野菜です。左から一覧の順です。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-09.translation: This is the meat, and this is the vegetables. From the left, they are in the order on the list.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見分けられました。友人と一本ずつ取って、五種類を食べ比べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 皿の順を理解し一本ずつ食べ比べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can tell them apart now. My friend and I will each take one skewer of each type and compare all five.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Understand the order on the plates and compare the types by taking one skewer each. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞお二人でお楽しみください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-12-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy them together. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 朝食のご注文はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you decided on your breakfast order?

DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 卵のセットをお願いします。パンを一つ追加して、追加分だけ持ち帰ることはできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 朝食と追加パンの持帰りを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-02.translation: The egg set, please. Can I add one piece of bread and take only that extra piece home?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about breakfast and taking home an extra piece of bread. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 追加のパンは袋に入れてお渡しできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can put the extra bread in a bag for you.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では一つ追加してください。セットのパンはここで食べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 店内分と追加一個を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then please add one. I will eat the bread included in the set here.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify the bread you will eat here and one extra piece. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 追加分は焼いてから袋に入れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-05.translation: Shall we toast the extra piece before putting it in the bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 後で家で焼きたいので、追加分は焼かずにお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 追加分は未加熱を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to toast it at home later, so please leave the extra piece untoasted.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request that the extra piece be left untoasted. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。お飲み物はいかがなさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-07.translation: Certainly. What would you like to drink?

DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: コーヒーにします。持ち帰りのパンは会計の時に受け取れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: コーヒーと会計時受取を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-08.translation: Coffee. Can I collect the takeaway bread when I pay?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Order coffee and ask to collect the bread when paying. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、お帰りの時にお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, we will give it to you when you leave.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: それでお願いします。食事中は袋を置かなくて済むので助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 帰り受取で食卓が空く利点を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do that. It helps because I will not need to keep a bag at the table during the meal.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that collecting it on departure keeps the table free during the meal. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご用意します。それでは、朝のお食事をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-13-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will prepare it. Please enjoy your breakfast.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 境内の案内図をお渡ししています。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-01.translation: We are handing out maps of the grounds.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 初めて来ました。いくつかお参りしたいので、入口から回る順番を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初参拝の三地点順序を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-02.translation: This is my first visit. I would like to worship at several places, so please tell me the order to visit them from the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: On your first worship visit, ask the order for the three locations. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この道から進むと、こちらの三つを順に回れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-03.translation: If you take this path, you can visit these three in order.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三つ目から出口へ行けますか。帰りに入口まで戻る必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最後から別出口へ行けるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-04.translation: Can I go to an exit from the third one? Do I need to return to the entrance on my way out?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can reach another exit from the last location. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 三つ目の先に別の出口があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is another exit beyond the third place.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その出口を使いたいです。道の曲がり角へ矢印を書いてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 曲がり角の矢印記入を提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to use that exit. May I draw an arrow at the bend in the path?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Suggest drawing an arrow at the turn. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。この角で右へ曲がると出口です。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Turn right at this corner to reach the exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 右矢印を付けました。途中の休憩場所はこの四角の印ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 休憩場所の地図記号を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have added a right arrow. Is this square mark the rest area along the way?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the map symbol for the rest area. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、案内所の横に休める場所があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, there is a place to rest beside the information office.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 参拝の間にそこで休んで、最後は右へ曲がります。図を見ながら歩きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 休憩を入れ出口へ回る計画を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will rest there between visits and turn right at the end. I will walk while checking the map.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Describe your plan to include a rest and continue to the exit. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞゆっくりお参りください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-14-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take your time visiting. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ショーの観覧場所をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-01.translation: I will show you the show-viewing area.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 歌を聞きたいので、スピーカーの正面を少し外した場所を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 音声位置を理由に横観覧位置を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to hear the singing, so I am looking for a spot a little away from directly in front of the speakers.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a viewing spot to the side because of the sound position. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 中央よりこちらの横側をご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can guide you to this side rather than the center.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この位置でも舞台の全体が見えますね。座って見る場所ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 舞台視界と着席区画を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can still see the whole stage from here. Is this a seated viewing area?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check the view of the stage and whether it is a seated section. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この区画は着席でご覧いただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-05.translation: You watch seated in this section.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここに座ります。開始までに飲み物を買って、同じ区画へ戻れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 購入後同じ区画へ戻る可否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will sit here. Can I buy a drink before the start and return to the same section?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can return to the same section after making a purchase. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 開始前でしたら戻れます。席を離れる時は荷物をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can return before the start. Please take your belongings when leaving your seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 荷物を持って行きます。戻る入口は今入った所と同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 荷物携行と再入口を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will take them with me. Is the entrance for returning the same one I just used?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will take your belongings and ask about the entrance for returning. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの横の入口へお戻りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please come back through this side entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 横の入口ですね。飲み物を買って、開始前にこの区画へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 横入口から開始前に戻る計画を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-10.translation: The side entrance, understood. I will buy a drink and return to this section before the start.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Describe your plan to return through the side entrance before the start. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞショーをお楽しみください。いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-15-001-SHARED-11.translation: Enjoy the show. See you when you return.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 花壇の案内図があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-01.translation: We have a guide map of the flowerbeds.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 花の名前を覚えながら歩きたいです。名前の札が付いている花壇はどこですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 名前札の花壇場所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to learn the flower names as I walk. Where are the flowerbeds with name labels?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where to find the flowerbeds with name labels. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの通路沿いに、番号付きの札があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-03.translation: There are numbered labels along this path.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 案内図の番号と同じなのですね。花がまだ咲いていない所もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 図番号と未開花植物を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-04.translation: So they match the numbers on the map. Are there also places where the flowers have not bloomed yet?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about the map numbers and plants that have not yet flowered. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。葉を見られる植物も、同じ図に載せています。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Plants whose leaves you can view are included on the same map too.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 葉の形も見てみます。手帳へ名前を書きたいので、途中に腰掛けられる場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 葉観察とメモ用ベンチを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will look at the leaf shapes as well. I want to write names in my notebook; is there somewhere to sit along the way?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will observe leaves and ask about a bench for taking notes. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 花壇の先にベンチがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is a bench beyond the flowerbeds.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そこで一度メモをまとめます。この小さい葉の絵は、常緑という意味ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 常緑の記号を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will organize my notes there. Does this little leaf picture mean evergreen?
DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the symbol for evergreen plants. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。凡例にも説明があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. It is also explained in the legend.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 凡例が見つかりました。番号と名前、葉の特徴を三つずつ書いて回ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 番号名前特徴を記録する散策を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-10.translation: I found the legend. I will walk around recording the number, name, and leaf characteristics for three plants at a time.
DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to walk around recording the numbers, names, and characteristics. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ散歩をお楽しみください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-027-16-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy your walk. Excuse me.
